event.location_text: 新加坡海峡（新加坡水域）

sources.title: Piracy monthly report April 2025
sources.text: Crew onboard the ship underway noticed three unauthorised persons and raised the alarm resulting in the persons escaping. A search was carried out and ship’s stores identified as stolen. Incident reported to Singapore Authorities who later boarded the ship for investigation.
